# PURPOSE (DDC-09): for each reported quantity, names WHICH object is authoritative (the
#   computed/measured thing) and maps every convenient proxy (recorder, export column, summary
#   stat, derived field) back to it — so a proxy is never assigned the authoritative object's
#   semantics.
# STATE CONTRACT: exactly ONE current authoritative_object per quantity. On change, supersede the
#   row IN PLACE + leave a dated retract stub (status=RETRACTED + as_of).
# NOTE: if this map is the project-wide A1 owner (not a scoped reference), set
#   AUTHORITY_CLASS=A1_CURRENT_OWNER; the SOURCE_HASH/SCOPE_AUTHORITY/NOT_AUTHORITY_FOR extension
#   above is required only for a scoped A2 reference.
# CHECKER enforces:
#   - in-band STATUS header present; if AUTHORITY_CLASS=A2_SECONDARY, SOURCE_HASH + SCOPE_AUTHORITY + NOT_AUTHORITY_FOR also present   (fail on missing field)
#   - each authoritative quantity lists its known proxies + the exact transform/relation to each   (fail on a proxy with no transform)
#   - each proxy row states what it does NOT hold                                                  (fail on empty does_NOT_hold for a proxy)
#   - reconstruction impossibility named explicitly (a proxy that cannot rebuild the object says so) (fail on empty reconstruction_from_proxy)
#   - at most one authoritative_object per quantity  [STATE contract]                              (fail on conflicting current owners)
# One row per (quantity, surface). The authoritative object gets its own row (proxy_surface = itself).
